---
title: Can I publish code in the Faculty Research Data Collection?
categories: [Faculty Research Data, Deposit]
---

The Faculty Research Data Collection supports deposits of any file type, including code. However, for primarily code-based datasets, we recommend publishing via [GitHub's Zenodo integration](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/archiving-a-github-repository/referencing-and-citing-content). 

Please contact [librarydataservices@berkeley.edu](mailto:librarydataservices@berkeley.edu) with questions.
